name: @lynn123411/dsh-ask-user-grilling
description: Form-presentation variant of the native ask_user_question: same tool description and shared-parameter descriptions verbatim, forced multi-select, an optional question number merged into the header, an optional markdown detail body, a recommendation marker normalized into the one label suffix the client renders, plus an auto-appended round-end supplement question. Its own browser half renders the transcript card for ask_user_grilling (question list, detail markdown, round-end supplement, rejected-round violations).

scripts.test: node scripts/test-recommendation.mjs && node scripts/test-card.mjs && node scripts/smoke-host.mjs && node scripts/test-render.mjs && node scripts/smoke-client.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm assert:lib-untracked
